 IMD Weather Today, November 10, 2026: Heavy Rain Alert in Tamil Nadu and Andaman, Thunderstorms in Several States
 By Jasreet Kaur Last Updated: Nov 10, 2026, 10:38 IST IMD has forecast heavy rainfall in Tamil Nadu and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands on November 10. Check the state-wise weather forecast, thunderstorm warnings, fog conditions and upcoming rain alerts.
 IMD Weather Today, November 10, 2026: Heavy Rain Alert in Tamil Nadu and Andaman, Thunderstorms in Several States 
 The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy rainfall in parts of southern India and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands on Tuesday, November 10, 2026. Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands are likely to receive heavy showers at isolated places. Here is the state-wise IMD weather forecast for November 10 and the coming days.
 Which States Will Receive Heavy Rain Today?
 According to the IMD’s All India Weather Forecast Bulletin issued on November 9, heavy rainfall is likely at isolated places in Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands on November 10.
 State or Region Weather Forecast for November 10 
 Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal Heavy rainfall at isolated places 
 Andaman and Nicobar Islands Heavy rainfall, thunderstorms, lightning, and gusty winds 
 Andhra Pradesh Thunderstorms, lightning, and gusty winds at isolated places 
 Kerala and Mahe Thunderstorms, lightning, and gusty winds at isolated places 
 Lakshadweep Thunderstorms, lightning, and gusty winds at isolated places 
 Bihar Thunderstorms and lightning at isolated places 
 Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram and Tripura Thunderstorms and lightning at isolated places 
 West Bengal and Sikkim Thunderstorms and lightning at isolated places 
 Tamil Nadu and Andaman Islands Under Heavy Rain Warning
 Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal may receive heavy rainfall at isolated places on November 10. Another spell of heavy rain is also possible on November 15. Thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds of 40–50 kmph are also likely at isolated places over the islands from November 9 to 13.
 Region Heavy Rainfall Forecast 
 Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal November 9–10 and November 15 
 Andaman and Nicobar Islands November 10–14 
 Kerala and Mahe November 9 
 Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram and Tripura November 11 
 Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh and adjoining regions November 12–13 
 Thunderstorms and Gusty Winds Expected in Several States
 The weather department has forecast thunderstorms and lightning in several parts of the country.
 State or Region Expected Weather 
 Andaman and Nicobar Islands Thunderstorms, lightning and winds of 40–50 kmph, gusting up to 60 kmph 
 Andhra Pradesh Thunderstorms, lightning and winds of 30–40 kmph 
 Kerala and Mahe Thunderstorms, lightning and winds of 30–40 kmph 
 Lakshadweep Thunderstorms, lightning and winds of 30–40 kmph 
 Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal Thunderstorms, lightning and winds of 30–40 kmph 
 Coastal Andhra Pradesh Strong surface winds possible 
 Western Disturbance to Bring Rain and Snowfall in Northern India
 The IMD has forecast isolated to scattered rainfall over Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh on November 10 and 11. Himachal Pradesh may receive isolated to scattered rainfall between November 10 and 15.
 Weather Forecast for Northeast India 
 Several northeastern states may experience rainfall and thunderstorms during the coming days. On November 10, thunderstorms accompanied by lightning are likely at isolated places in Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram and Tripura. The IMD has also forecast isolated to scattered rainfall over Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Meghalaya and the northeastern states from November 9 to 12.
 Weather Forecast for the Coming Days: November 11 to 15
 Rainfall activity is expected to continue in parts of southern, northeastern and eastern India, while the western Himalayan region may experience a fresh spell of precipitation.

 November 12–15 Punjab Isolated rainfall

 November 15 Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal Isolated heavy rainfall 
 November 15 Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh Isolated rainfall and thunderstorms
